message:
2 speaking attributes carry a string written inline:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:32: title="Remove the item"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.html:33: value="Send the form"
description: Speaking attributes on elements inline templates wrap: a `title` under `*ngFor`, and the `value` of a submit `<input>` under `*ngIf`. The template carries each attribute hoisted, the same object as its element's, and the walk is handed it twice; read twice, each was two refusals, and only the read with the element can tell that the `value` speaks — a read that kept the first visit lost it.
